task.title: Refund a Payment
task.shortdesc: Return funds to a buyer for a completed PayPal capture — full or partial.

ul.li: A completed capture with status COMPLETED
Transaction within 180 days of capture date

step.cmd: Send a POST request to the refund endpoint with the capture ID.

info.p: For a full refund, omit the amount field:
info.codeblock: curl -X POST \ https://api-m.sandbox.paypal.com/v2/payments/captures/3C679366HH908993F/refund \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer A21AAFEpH4PsADbl..." \ -H "PayPal-Request-Id: refund-20240915-001" \ -d '{ "note_to_payer": "Refund for order cancellation" }'
info.p: For a partial refund, include the amount:

step.stepresult: Refund initiated. The buyer receives funds within the timeline for their funding source.

result.p: The refund is complete. PayPal sends the buyer an email confirmation. Refund processing times vary by the buyer's funding source.

note.p: The PayPal fee from the original transaction is returned to you when you issue a full refund. Partial refunds do not return the fee proportionally.
